question: Should `openclawProgressKind: "tool-progress"` become the supported generic public plugin-SDK contract for transient tool progress?
rationale: The PR expands third-party plugin API surface; repository policy supports a generic typed seam, but a maintainer must confirm that this is the permanent public contract rather than a private or narrower owner-specific mechanism.

options.title: Keep the generic marker
options.body: Approve the closed generic SDK marker, then require complete structured-payload propagation, contract coverage, and exact-head proof before merge.

options.title: Keep it internal
options.body: Avoid new public SDK surface and redesign producer-to-channel propagation through an existing internal or plugin-local contract.

recommendation.title: Keep the generic marker
recommendation.body: Approve the closed generic SDK marker, then require complete structured-payload propagation, contract coverage, and exact-head proof before merge.
